The heart behind the music

Worship beyond the sound.

WILLIAMS P MUSIC is a Nigerian gospel music artist, singer and songwriter whose music is rooted in faith, praise and gratitude to God. Through African gospel sounds and heartfelt worship, the mission is to lift up the name of Jesus and inspire people everywhere to give God all the glory.

“Rooted in faith, grounded in love.”
